description: Opt-in GLM packed-research allocation on sm_121. Routed logical expert units and aggregate stacks permit legal Tessera E4M3 K1 rungs or plain BF16 source passthrough. Dense readable families retain the inherited policy. This allocation restriction is not a serving qualification or export lane; per-unit context, shape and source-precision gates remain mandatory, and TP2 qualification is separate.

format_rules.detail: GLM packed research permits only legal Tessera E4M3 K1 routed rungs or plain BF16 source passthrough; Tessera E2M1, BF16-body and unrelated formats are unsupported by this research builder.
